title: Survive The Reset Sci-Fi Survival Game
author: Regular-Dingo-2872
selftext:
So over more than 5 months so far starting with Pro versions of GPT & Claude & also Cursor using Grok 4.6, Between these 3 I could pretty much keep making the game without any disruptions. All connected to my local file and only for coding. It started with a procedural dome like landscape. Recently I have only being using Claude as the file is so big now the others dont really match Fable 5.1 & 5.2



Inspirations from so many survival games.. I have a dragonfly spaceship, submarine.. Houseboat.. a story about blowing up the sky... Classic survival mechanics. Fish breeding for buffs...

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5269640/Survive\_The\_Reset/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5269640/Survive_The_Reset/)
